summary: Noah Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K on September 15, 2026, attaching its 2026 Interim Report as Exhibit 99.1, signed by CFO Qing Pan. The filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer report of interim financial results under the 1934 Act, not a special situation. No transaction terms, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated. The interim report provides standard interim disclosure. What to watch: ordinary interim results and any forward guidance, with no risk-arb angle.
